title: Performized
description: Performized aims to improve Minecraft's performance to the best of its ability.
body:
**By using, modifying, or distributing this Modpack, you agree to the [Performized Public License](https://performized.lovable.app).**      

![performized](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/420009148bfc3127ff4b622f8ae960f0cc8a5fa7.png)

**Performized offers great performance with no extra non-optimization mods built-in! It is for players that solely want performance and add their mods in, or like Vanilla Minecraft, or those who want to add their own mods and make a new modpack, but please follow our license when doing so.**

Performized is an **advanced optimization modpack** built for players who want **maximum performance without sacrificing any quality**. Whether you’re building mega bases, adding all of these mods to your own modpack, or just want buttery-smooth vanilla gameplay, we have you covered!

> **Performized also has a Quilt version!** Play without Fabric and keep all the performance. Huge flexibility for players and pack makers.
# 👀 Performance Improvements

Performized aims to improve your performance while you are in the game, normally, in both multiplayer and single-player.

# ❤️ Fully Maintained

This project stays automatically up to date through our Discord bot, which automatically updates Performized so you always get the latest version and the newest mod updates as fast as possible.

<details>
<summary>The Versioning System</summary>

# The New Versioning System of Performized

The versioning system of Performized follows a pattern of: "<Grade>.<Version>"

The grade is determined as follows:

1 = 50% to 60% of the mods that Performized is using are compatible with the Performized version.

2 = 60% to 70% of the mods that Performized is using are compatible with the Performized version.

3 = 70% to 80% of the mods that Performized is using are compatible with the Performized version.

4 = 80% to 90% of the mods that Performized is using are compatible with the Performized version.

5 = Over 90% of the mods that Performized is using are compatible with the Performized version.

The version number resets every time a new grade comes.

This versioning system is hereby introduced as of the 27th of May.

</details>
